Theorem 1 (Chapter 135)

Subject: differential geometry | ID: 86673

Corollary

If X is a real manifold and T: X -> X is a differentiable operator, then T admits a unique decomposition T = D + N where D is diagonalizable and N is nilpotent.

Proof

Step 1. The trace-free operator \(P_{01350011}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle P_{01350011} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Step 2. By the singular spectral theorem, we decompose \(B_{01350012} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the singular spectral family.

Step 3. By the continuous spectral theorem, we decompose \(Q_{01350013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the continuous spectral family.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the nonlinear convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01350011 \cdot C_01350012 \cdot C_01350013\).
